title: ¿Por qué a los 33 mineros de Chile los sacaron en una cápsula? ⛏️
staging_mode_proposal: cutaway: the hill cut open from the surface down to the refuge, so the blocked ramp, the probe holes and the rescue shaft are in one section.
curiosity_reason: The rescue was followed live across the Spanish-speaking world and beyond; the capsule is iconic; dangerous. Fame evidence in the bank entry.
hook_question: ¿Por qué a los 33 mineros de Chile los sacaron en una cápsula y no por el túnel de la mina?
false_belief: Los rescataron por el mismo túnel por donde entraron.
turn: Scene 4: seventeen days in, a probe drill comes back up with a note tied to it: they are alive, and the thin hole becomes their lifeline.
closing_reframe: La salida no fue el túnel de la mina: fue el hoyo por donde subió su primer mensaje.
share_archetype: ese amigo que se mete a una cueva sin avisarle a nadie
engine_reason: code3d (engine selection: rigid rock strata in section, straight drill strings, a cylindrical capsule): hill section, ramp, rock block, drill and capsule are geometric builds; the miners are the sealed human-figure (standing, seated).
description:
¿Por qué a los 33 mineros de Chile los sacaron en una cápsula? Porque una roca gigante tapó la única rampa de salida.
Primero los encontró una sonda fina, que subió con un papel: 'Estamos bien'. ⛏️
Envíaselo a ese amigo que se mete a una cueva sin avisarle a nadie.
wardrobe: human-figure, standing and seated poses only (sealed). Miners: fig_shirt and fig_pants in one dusty work colour, fig_boots dark; no helmet lamps beyond a small accent dot on the head; no faces (the figure is faceless). No likeness of any real miner.

scenes.name: hook
scenes.narration: ¿Por qué a los 33 mineros de Chile los sacaron en una cápsula y no por el túnel de la mina? Muchos creen que salieron por donde entraron.
scenes.what_changes: A hill in the desert, cut open: a ramp spirals down inside it; at the top a narrow steel capsule rises out of a hole in the ground; the tag ¿POR EL TÚNEL? points at the ramp's mouth.
scenes.transformation: cerro cortado → una cápsula sale por un hoyo y no por la rampa
scenes.camera: órbita desde la boca de la mina hasta el hoyo de la cápsula

elements.name: a mine cut open inside a hill, with a ramp spiralling down
elements.route: build: layered rock section, helical ramp, desert surface (no library asset)
elements.risk: high: an abstract section may read as a 'cake' or 'layers'; the ramp mouth and the capsule are the cue; proof P1

scenes.name: derrumbe
scenes.narration: En agosto de dos mil diez, en la mina San José, en Chile, una roca del tamaño de un edificio tapó la única rampa de salida.
scenes.what_changes: Deep in the section, a huge block of rock breaks off and drops across the ramp; dust bursts out along the tunnel; the ramp below the block is sealed.
scenes.transformation: rampa abierta → un bloque gigante la tapa
scenes.camera: bajada por la rampa y frenazo cuando cae el bloque

elements.name: a huge rock collapsing onto a mine tunnel
elements.route: build: rigid rock block falling across the ramp in the section; dust as a stylised particle burst

scenes.name: refugio
scenes.narration: Treinta y tres mineros quedaron abajo, a unos setecientos metros. Arriba, nadie sabía si estaban vivos.
scenes.what_changes: Down at the bottom of the section, a small lit room: thirty-three figures gather in it; far above, on the surface, the drill rigs arrive and set up.
scenes.transformation: mina en silencio → mineros en el refugio y máquinas llegando arriba
scenes.camera: subida vertical desde el refugio hasta la superficie, setecientos metros de roca

elements.name: a group of miners in an underground room
elements.route: human-figure (sealed, standing and seated), 33 instances in a lit chamber in the rock section
elements.risk: medium: sealed asset and poses; the rock around them is the cue for 'underground'; proof P1 covers the section

scenes.name: mensaje
scenes.narration: Perforaron hoyos finos, a ciegas. Diecisiete días después, una sonda llegó al refugio, y volvió a subir con un papel amarrado: 'Estamos bien en el refugio los 33'.
scenes.what_changes: The turn: thin drill strings bore down through the section, missing the refuge; one breaks through its ceiling; it is pulled back up, and at the surface a folded paper hangs from its tip and opens.
scenes.transformation: sondas a ciegas → una llega al refugio y sube con el mensaje
scenes.camera: seguimiento de la sonda hacia abajo y de vuelta hacia arriba con el papel

elements.name: a drill bit with a paper note tied to it
elements.route: build: drill string and bit, folded paper with a tie; the paper carries no readable text (the words are in the narration and subtitles)
elements.risk: high: a paper on a rod may read as a 'flag'; proof P3

scenes.name: palomas
scenes.narration: Por ese hoyo les bajaron comida, agua y cartas, en tubos que llamaron palomas.
scenes.what_changes: Slim tubes slide down the thin hole one after another and arrive in the refuge; the figures open them.
scenes.transformation: hoyo vacío → tubos con comida que bajan al refugio
scenes.camera: travelling vertical junto a los tubos que bajan

elements.name: tubes sliding down a narrow borehole
elements.route: build: slim capsules in the borehole of the section
elements.risk: medium: secondary; read with the scene

scenes.name: taladro
scenes.narration: Volver por la rampa era imposible: el bloque seguía ahí y la roca seguía cayendo. Así que ensancharon un hoyo hasta que cupiera una persona. Tardaron más de un mes.
scenes.what_changes: Beside the blocked ramp, chips of rock still fall; on the surface a large drill bores a wider shaft down beside the thin one, its bit chewing through the strata; a day counter runs.
scenes.transformation: hoyo fino → un pozo ancho que baja hasta el refugio
scenes.camera: travelling hacia abajo siguiendo la broca grande
overlays_plan: mark red X on the ramp at 'imposible'

elements.name: a large drill boring a shaft down through rock
elements.route: build: drill rig on the surface, wide bit in the section
elements.risk: medium-high: proof P2 shares the rock section; the rig is the cue

scenes.name: capsula
scenes.narration: En octubre bajó una cápsula de acero, apenas más ancha que un hombre, y los subió uno por uno. A los sesenta y nueve días, habían salido los treinta y tres.
scenes.what_changes: A narrow steel capsule descends the wide shaft, a figure steps in, and it rises to the surface; the trip repeats faster and faster while a counter climbs to 33, and the refuge empties.
scenes.transformation: 33 abajo → uno por uno suben en la cápsula hasta que el refugio queda vacío
scenes.camera: seguimiento de la cápsula subiendo por el pozo

elements.name: a narrow rescue capsule rising up a shaft with a person inside
elements.route: build: tall steel cylinder cage with a figure inside, winch line, in the shaft of the section
elements.risk: high: a cylinder in a shaft may read as an 'elevator' or 'rocket'; proof P4

scenes.name: cierre
scenes.narration: Así que la salida no fue el túnel de la mina: fue el hoyo por donde subió su primer mensaje. Envíaselo a ese amigo que se mete a una cueva sin avisarle a nadie.
scenes.what_changes: Single reframe image: the whole section: the ramp still blocked, and beside it the thin hole and the wide shaft lit in the accent from the empty refuge to the surface.
scenes.transformation: rescate terminado → el corte entero con el hoyo y el pozo encendidos junto a la rampa tapada
scenes.camera: retroceso desde el refugio vacío hasta el cerro entero

sources: The collapse on 5 August 2010 at the San José mine near Copiapó, Atacama region, Chile, trapping 33 miners about 700 m underground and about 5 km from the entrance: Encyclopaedia Britannica 'Chile mine rescue of 2010'; Interesting Engineering 'The improbable rescue of Los 33' (live search 2026-11-11). FLAGGED: confirm the date at the beat sheet.

The ramp blocked by a single huge block (the 'megabloque'). FLAGGED: 'del tamaño de un edificio' needs a source giving its size at the beat sheet (it is commonly reported as about 700,000 t, the height of a 45-storey building); if none is read, the narration says 'una roca gigante', with the same staging.

Day 17 (22 August 2010): a probe drill reached the refuge and returned with the note 'Estamos bien en el refugio los 33'. FLAGGED: not confirmed by the 2026-11-11 search; read it in Britannica or a Chilean government source at the beat sheet. The story does not stand without the turn, so if it cannot be sourced the topic is returned (format policy 'Historia', Sourcing).
Supplies sent down the borehole in tubes called 'palomas'. FLAGGED: confirm at the beat sheet; if unsourced, scene 5 drops the name and keeps the tubes.

Plan B (Schramm T130XD) widened a pilot hole and reached the miners on 9 October 2010 after about a month of drilling; the pilot hole was about 12 inches wide (Wikipedia 'Rescue plans for 2010 Copiapó mining accident', live search 2026-11-11). Spoken as 'más de un mes'. FLAGGED: confirm the start date of Plan B drilling at the beat sheet.

The Fénix 2 capsule: a 3.95 m steel cylinder 'just wide enough to hold one man'; each ascent about 15 minutes; Operation San Lorenzo from 23:00 on 12 October; all 33 out 69 days after the collapse (Wikipedia 'Fénix capsules'; Britannica Kids 'Chile mine rescue of 2010'). Spoken as 'apenas más ancha que un hombre' and 'a los sesenta y nueve días'.
Return through the ramp impossible: the block and continuing instability (same Britannica article). FLAGGED with the block size.
simplifications: The mine is a stylised section; the real ramp winds about 5 km; the refuge, the holes and the shaft are drawn closer together than they were.
Several probe holes and three drilling plans are reduced to a few probes and one large drill.
The capsule is a plain steel cage without the national colours it carried.

historia_checks.one_complete_story: From the collapse to the last miner out; the outcome (all 33 out, day 69) is told in scene 7 before the reframe. Not serialized.
historia_checks.mechanism_heart: Remove the mechanism sentences (blind probe drilling, the note on the bit, the supply tubes, the widened shaft, the one-man capsule) and only 'they were trapped and got out' remains. PASS.
historia_checks.people: Stylised faceless figures (sealed human-figure); no real miner is shown or named.

flatness_test: 1. hook: the hill in section; a capsule rises out of a hole, not the ramp.
2. derrumbe: a huge rock drops and seals the ramp.
3. refugio: 33 figures in the refuge below; drill rigs arrive on the surface.
4. mensaje: probes bore down blind; one breaks into the refuge and comes up with a note (turn).
5. palomas: supply tubes slide down the thin hole into the refuge.
6. taladro: a big drill bores a wide shaft beside the blocked ramp.
7. capsula: the capsule lifts the miners one by one until the refuge is empty.
8. cierre: the whole section with the hole and shaft lit beside the blocked ramp.
